subject: Temporary P1 response exception request for DR migration window
messages:
From: Tara Patel <tara.patel@opsworks.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Mike Lo <mike.lo@opsworks.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary P1 response exception request for DR migration window

Hi Rishi,

We're planning a planned DR migration (primary -> hot-standby failover test) next week (Apr 22-23) that will generate a higher-than-normal rate of alerts during the 02:00-06:00 PDT window. Ops team would like to request a temporary adjustment to the P1 SLA behavior for that migration window so we can coordinate noisy alerts without triggering full-production escalations. Specifically we are asking that Redwood treat P1 incidents opened between 02:00-06:00 PDT on Apr 22 and Apr 23 as "migration-mode" for the purposes of Pager escalation for up to 4 hours from the event, with primary mitigation required but with a longer response target (30 minutes rather than the usual 15).

Attached is the migration plan (opsworks_migration_plan_v2.pdf) and a high-level runbook. We understand this is an exception to our contract; OpsWorks is prepared to sign a short amendment for the migration window. Could you confirm whether Redwood can approve a temporary SLA adjustment, and what internal approvals you need?

Thanks — Tara
Tara Patel
Head of Platform Ops, OpsWorks

Attachments: opsworks_migration_plan_v2.pdf

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Tara Patel <tara.patel@opsworks.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Temporary P1 response exception request for DR migration window

Tara — thanks for the clear plan and the heads up. I read the migration plan and the ask is reasonable as a short-lived operational carveout, but I need to validate both from an operational and a contractual standpoint.

Operationally I want to confirm: 1) that you will notify Redwood 48 hours in advance (we have it now, good), 2) the exact migration windows (02:00-06:00 PDT Apr 22 & Apr 23), and 3) the expected volume multiplier you anticipate.

Operational proposal from our side: we can treat incidents during the specified window as migration-mode with an internal target of 30 minutes response for P1s, provided OpsWorks accepts the following mitigations:
- an on-call overlap (we'll add a second responder on both nights from 01:30–05:30 PDT)
- a manual watch channel (we'll run a shared Slack bridge and a short joint call during the first hour)
- automatic rolling fallback to standard SLA if an incident meets our severity escalation criteria

For contract/workflow: please have your legal sign a timeboxed amendment (we can route a DocuSign link). Priyom, can you advise on how this should be costed/approved on the deal? Laura/Vivek — can you confirm the on-call adjustments are feasible?

I'll stand by for the signed amendment and the final confirmation of expected alert volume.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

Rishi/Tara — operationally we can support this for a strictly timeboxed window with the mitigations Rishi suggested. We will:
- add a secondary responder on Apr 22 & 23 from 01:30–05:30 PDT (on-call roster attached)
- create a shared Slack channel for live triage and add an on-call incident commander (IC) for the window
- enable a migration-mode flag in monitoring so incidents have a migration tag for post-mortem filtering

Escalation path (short):
1) Primary responder (within 30 min target during migration window)
2) Secondary responder (on-call overlap)
3) Incident Commander (Vivek)
4) If unresolved after 4 hours OR service-impacting at customer-facing layer -> immediate SLA fallback and exec notification (Rishi/Laura)

I've attached the proposed on-call overlap roster (redwood_oncall_roster_apr21-23.csv). We'll instrument extra telemetry on request. If OpsWorks confirms the expected alert multiplier is >5x we'll schedule a pre-migration runbook rehearsal.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Support Lead, Redwood Inference

I will prepare a 2-paragraph amendment and route via DocuSign.

Requested items to include when you sign: migration dates/times, exact response target (30 mins), list of mitigation commitments (on-call overlap, shared channel), and the automatic fallback clause.

I've created the DocuSign envelope and will send to Tara's legal once you (Tara) approve the final text. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/tx/0a1b2c3d4e5f
